question: Should OpenClaw expose restart-required runtime-config drift as a supported health payload after the implementation is moved to reloader-owned prepared state?
rationale: The code defect has a clear repair, but adding a durable health contract for model/provider/auth drift is a product and owner-boundary choice rather than a purely mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Expose Prepared Drift
options.body: Retain the diagnostic using reloader-owned state, non-sensitive read-scope output, and admin-only fingerprints or detailed errors.

options.title: Keep Existing Status Only
options.body: Do not add the separate `runtimeConfig` health block and continue relying on reload logs plus the existing watcher-status diagnostic.

recommendation.title: Expose Prepared Drift
recommendation.body: Retain the diagnostic using reloader-owned state, non-sensitive read-scope output, and admin-only fingerprints or detailed errors.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the closest reloader-owned health diagnostic and cache-freshness architecture.
